entities.title: Whether and how to publish Handyman Jim on icelander.net
entities.summary: The game runs in a browser from its Web export, but nothing in this repository serves it yet.
entities.context: Every published game here is an npm project with a Cloudflare Worker that checks icelander.net's sign-in, and a merge to main deploys any game with a package.json. Handyman Jim is a plain Godot project with a Web export preset (threads off, so it needs no special headers) and no Worker.

options.title: Leave it as source only
options.consequences: Nothing to deploy or maintain; players need Godot or a separately hosted build.

options.title: Publish it like Gambit
options.consequences: Needs a package.json, a Worker that serves the web export behind the site's sign-in, a wrangler.jsonc, deployment and delivery files, and Godot export templates in the deploy workflow.

options.title: Host the web export elsewhere (itch.io, GitHub Pages)
options.consequences: No sign-in or high scores; the README's web section already describes the export.
